_comment: First to 9; halftime after 8; at 8-8 overtime until a player leads by 2, sides swapping every 2
overtime rounds with everyone's money set to overtime.money. Each player has their own money
(start 800, max 9,000, win 2,700 / 3,000 with the charge, loss bonus 1,400 + 500 per loss up
to 2,900). No preparation phase; specialists and gadgets on; no drones or cameras. The map's
'duel' layout (maps/data/<map>.json modes.duel): one bomb site, one spawn per side, player-clip
